Local models vs Gemini on the 20 bench sheets

Ranking

Overall = mean of three scores: key-field agreement, all-field agreement (both against Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash; a Gemini model is scored only against the other Gemini models), and the GBIF name check. The Jouvea test is shown beside it, not mixed in (one sheet).

    Quality vs speed (local)

    Each dot is one local configuration: x = images per minute for the 20-sheet batch on this workstation (log scale), y = overall score. Dashed lines mark the Gemini models' overall scores.

    Reasoning off vs max

    Same model, reasoning off (left dot) and at its highest level (right dot; Muse: medium). The label gives the change in overall score and how many times longer the batch took.

    Agreement by field

    Mean agreement with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash for every field of SLTPvM_full, only where either side had a value. Rows follow the ranking. Darker = closer to Gemini.

    Jouvea test
